description: Split a pane in two: the new pane goes to its right or below it, starts in that pane's current directory (or cwd) and runs the default shell (or command). It becomes the window's active pane unless select is false. Like tmux, splitting a zoomed window unzooms it. With remain_on_exit, the new pane stays once its program ends, dead, for tmux::panes::respawn to restart it.

SplitDirection.description: Where a split puts the new pane.

oneOf.description: To the right of the pane (tmux `split-window -h`).

command.description: Shell command to run instead of the default shell.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or `~/…`. Defaults to the split pane's current directory.

direction.description: Where the new pane goes: `right` or `below`.

remain_on_exit.description: Keep the new pane once its program ends, shown dead, so tmux::panes::respawn can restart it (default false: tmux closes it). On tmux before 3.0, which has no pane options, every pane of its window is kept.

select.description: Make the new pane the window's active pane (default true).
